name: normal-test-actor
title: Apify normal test actor
description: Fake book scraper used for MCP server testing. Scrapes a built-in catalogue of fictional books (with varied JSON shapes) into the 'books' aliased dataset, and additionally computes the sum of two input integers into the default dataset and key-value store records (RESULT, STATS, LOG, COVER).

firstNumber.sectionDescription: Two integers pushed to the default dataset along with derived nested math (fibonacci, factorials, primality).
firstNumber.title: First number
firstNumber.description: First addend. Bounded so derived math operations stay tractable.

secondNumber.title: Second number
secondNumber.description: Second addend. Bounded so derived math operations stay tractable.

maxBooks.sectionDescription: Controls the fake book scraper that writes to the 'books' aliased dataset.
maxBooks.title: Max books to scrape
maxBooks.description: Maximum number of books to scrape. Defaults to all available books in the fixture.

waitSeconds.title: Wait seconds
waitSeconds.description: Number of seconds to wait before computing the sum.
